_note: Web-edition overrides and additions merged over design/desktop-offline-ui/strings.json by web/tools/build_site.py. {placeholders} are runtime values; <b>/<u> are emphasis only.

zh.rulesOff: 规则集 R6 · 在本机浏览器处理
zh.dropN: 文件只在本机浏览器里读取，不会上传
zh.okSub: 文件完整，可以用它升级路由器，也会在第 4 步用来生成桥接包。
zh.okSubDl: 已下载到浏览器里。第 3 步升级路由器时需要这个文件，请先保存到本机。
zh.dlOpenHint: 下载很慢或失败时，也可以用「新标签页打开」下载，再把文件拖到下面。
zh.tooBig: 文件太大，不可能是支持的官方固件。
zh.s4l: 用同一份官方固件生成桥接包。全部在本机浏览器里完成，不会上传任何文件。
zh.outNote: 生成并完整核验通过后，由浏览器保存到默认的下载位置。
zh.genFine: 生成后会再完整核验一遍；核验不通过不会保存。
zh.loadingRules: 正在加载 {m} 的规则数据…
zh.loadingRulesN: 约 {s} MB，每次打开页面只加载一次
zh.noClose: 处理中请不要关闭或刷新页面
zh.doneS: 浏览器已开始保存桥接包。没看到下载时，点「保存桥接包」。下一步把它上传到路由器官方后台。
zh.rulesBadS: 规则数据没有完整加载或已损坏。请刷新页面重试；如果是从压缩包打开的，请重新下载完整的网页版压缩包并解压后再打开。
zh.rulesLoadS: 请检查网络后重试。从压缩包打开时，请先完整解压，并保持 data 文件夹和 index.html 在一起。
zh.inputBadT: 官方固件校验没有通过
zh.inputBadS: 内存中的官方固件和指定版本不一致，已停止。请回到第 2 步重新选择文件。
zh.outBadS: 生成结果和预期的 SHA-256 不一致，已丢弃，没有保存任何文件。请复制诊断信息反馈。
zh.memS: 请关闭其他标签页后重试，或改用电脑上的最新版 Chrome / Edge / Firefox。
zh.offlineUpd: 网页版不会自动更新。在线打开时总是当前发布的版本；离线使用的压缩包请到发布页下载新版本。
zh.about:
BootBridge 网页版 {v} · 规则集 R6 · 引擎 v{e}
GPL-2.0-or-later · 所有处理都在本机浏览器里完成
zh.sumNote: 可以对照发布页的 SHA256SUMS 核对文件。
zh.readErrS: 浏览器无法读取这个文件。请把文件复制到「下载」等普通文件夹后重新选择。
zh.eNet: 无法连接到 H3C 服务器。请检查网络后重试，或用「新标签页打开」手动下载。
zh.fetchNote: H3C 没有公开这个版本的下载链接，需要用路由器的 SN 向 H3C 官方查询。浏览器拿不到这个临时链接，所以网页会生成一条命令，在你的电脑上运行即可下载并自动校验。
zh.snLabel: 路由器 SN（机身底部标签，或管理后台「设备信息」）
zh.snPrivacy: SN 只会发送给 H3C 官方服务器 magic.h3c.com（预检时由网页发送，下载时由命令发送）；网页不保存、不发送到其他任何地方。
zh.snChars: SN 只包含字母和数字
zh.snLen: SN 应为 20 位（当前 {n} 位）
zh.snChecking: 正在向 H3C 官方核对…
zh.snOk: H3C 已确认可以为这台路由器提供 {v}。
zh.snUnknown: H3C 不认识这个 SN。请对照机身标签再核对一遍，注意 0 和 O、1 和 I、5 和 S 等容易看错的字符。
zh.snFormat: H3C 认为 SN 格式不对。请对照机身标签重新输入。
zh.snOther: H3C 现在给这台路由器的是 {f}，不是本向导审核过的 {v}，命令也不会下载它。请等待 BootBridge 更新。
zh.snRejected: H3C 拒绝了查询（retCode {f}）。请核对 SN 后重试。
zh.snNet: 网页没能连上 H3C 做预检（{f}），可能是网络、代理或浏览器插件拦截。仍可以直接运行下面的命令，命令会自己再向 H3C 查询。
zh.snHttp: H3C 服务器返回 HTTP {f}，请稍后重试。
zh.snBad: H3C 的回复格式不符合预期，已停止。
zh.cmdT: 在电脑上运行下载命令
zh.cmdWinHow: 按 Win + X，选择「Windows PowerShell」或「终端」，粘贴整段命令后按回车。Windows 7 需要先安装 PowerShell 5.1 和 TLS 1.2 更新。
zh.cmdShHow: 打开「终端」，粘贴整段命令后按回车。需要系统自带的 curl。
zh.cmdAfter: 完成后，文件 {f} 会保存在「下载」文件夹。把它拖到下面的框里确认。
zh.cmdSafe: 命令只连接 magic.h3c.com 和 H3C 官方 OSS，下载后按指定的大小和 SHA-256 校验，不一致会自动删除。命令里含有你的 SN，不要公开分享。
zh.copyFail: 复制失败，请手动选择文字复制
zh.privacyLine: 固件文件只在本机浏览器里处理，不会上传
zh.s6recT: 以后要进入 U-Boot 恢复页：
zh.s6rec: 系统启动失败时，路由器会自动进入恢复页；也可以先断电，按住 Reset 键再通电，保持几秒后松开。电脑网卡保持「自动获取 IP」即可拿到 192.168.10.x 地址，然后在浏览器打开 192.168.10.1。

en.rulesOff: Rule set R6 · processed in your browser
en.dropN: The file is read in your browser only and never uploaded
en.okSub: The file is intact. Use it to upgrade the router; it will also be used in step 4.
en.okSubDl: Downloaded into the browser. You need this file to upgrade the router in step 3, so save it first.
en.savedAs: Handed to the browser to save: {f}
en.dlOpenHint: If the download is slow or fails, use “Open in new tab” to download it and drop the file below.
en.tooBig: This file is far too large to be a supported official firmware.
en.s4l: Build the bridge from the same official file. Everything happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
en.outNote: After it is built and fully verified, the browser saves it to your usual download location.
en.genFine: The output is fully verified again; nothing is saved if verification fails.
en.loadingRulesN: About {s} MB, loaded once per visit
en.noClose: Please keep this page open and do not reload
en.doneS: The browser has started saving the bridge. If no download appears, click “Save bridge”. Next, upload it from the router's admin page.
en.rulesBadS: The rule data did not load completely or is damaged. Reload the page and try again; if you opened it from a ZIP, download the complete web package again and extract it first.
en.rulesLoadS: Check your connection and try again. When using the ZIP, extract it completely and keep the data folder next to index.html.
en.inputBadS: The firmware in memory does not match the required version. Go back to step 2 and choose the file again.
en.outBadS: The result did not match the expected SHA-256 and was discarded; nothing was saved. Please copy the diagnostics and report it.
en.memT: The browser ran out of memory
en.memS: Close other tabs and try again, or use the latest Chrome / Edge / Firefox on a computer.
en.offlineUpd: The web edition never updates itself. Online it is always the current release; for the offline ZIP, download a new version from the release page.
en.about:
BootBridge Web {v} · Rule set R6 · Engine v{e}
GPL-2.0-or-later · Everything runs in your browser
en.sumNote: Files can be checked against SHA256SUMS on the release page.
en.readErrS: The browser could not read this file. Copy it to an ordinary folder such as Downloads and choose it again.
en.eNet: Could not reach H3C's server. Check your connection and try again, or use “Open in new tab” to download manually.
en.fetchNote: H3C does not publish a link for this version; it has to be requested from H3C with your router's SN. Browsers cannot obtain that temporary link, so this page builds a command you run on your computer to download and verify it.
en.snLabel: Router SN (label on the bottom, or Device Info in the admin page)
en.snPrivacy: The SN goes only to H3C's official server magic.h3c.com (sent by this page for the pre-check, and by the command for the download). It is never stored or sent anywhere else.
en.snChars: The SN contains only letters and digits
en.snOk: H3C confirmed it can provide {v} for this router.
en.snUnknown: H3C does not recognise this SN. Compare it with the label again; watch out for 0/O, 1/I and 5/S.
en.snFormat: H3C says the SN format is wrong. Please re-enter it from the label.
en.snOther: H3C currently offers {f} for this router, not the reviewed {v}, and the command would not download it. Please wait for a BootBridge update.
en.snRejected: H3C refused the query (retCode {f}). Check the SN and try again.
en.snNet: This page could not reach H3C for the pre-check ({f}); a network, proxy or browser extension may be blocking it. You can still run the command below; it asks H3C itself.
en.snHttp: H3C's server returned HTTP {f}. Please try again later.
en.snBad: H3C's reply was not in the expected format; stopped.
en.cmdT: Run the download command on your computer
en.cmdWinHow: Press Win + X, choose “Windows PowerShell” or “Terminal”, paste the whole command and press Enter. Windows 7 needs PowerShell 5.1 and the TLS 1.2 update first.
en.cmdShHow: Open Terminal, paste the whole command and press Enter. Uses the built-in curl.
en.cmdAfter: When it finishes, {f} is in your Downloads folder. Drop it into the box below to confirm.
en.cmdSafe: The command only contacts magic.h3c.com and H3C's official OSS, and checks the size and SHA-256 after downloading; a mismatch is deleted automatically. It contains your SN, so do not share it publicly.
en.copyFail: Copy failed; please select the text and copy it manually
en.privacyLine: Firmware files are processed in your browser and never uploaded
en.s6rec: If the system fails to boot, the router opens the recovery page automatically. You can also power it off, hold Reset while powering on, and release after a few seconds. Leave the network adapter on automatic (DHCP) to get a 192.168.10.x address, then open 192.168.10.1 in your browser.
